Players Committee card image of [[Bow To The First Order (ALT) (Errata)|Bow To The First Order (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, may take Finalizer into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per character, when you deploy Hux, Kylo, Phasma, or Snoke to an [Episode VII] battleground, may take any one card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/bowtothefirstorder_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6cae8c9ca0ffa879985fee5c01eca246364add0d 6cae8c9] (20 January 2026). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
